fields.statement: At 3414d9ac7 (attempt 2), in a detached checkout: go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run 'ShipPushDiverged|TestShipFollow|TestShipRebase' -v -count=1 PASS. TestShipPushDivergedMergesOrigin (ship.open-pr and ship.rebase subtests) uses scratch repos with a bare origin. Another clone pushes a commit on theirs.txt to origin's cs/ship-it, and the local branch commits mine.txt. The step merges (a merge commit exists), pushes, origin's ref equals local HEAD, and the history keeps 'earlier push'. TestShipPushDivergedConflictStops (both steps) makes a conflicting clash.txt: the error names 'earlier push', there is no MERGE_HEAD, HEAD is unmoved and nothing is pushed. noForceOrRebase records every git call through ctx.Git and ctx.Exec and finds no rebase, --force, -f, --force-with-lease or +refspec. Read shipMergeOrigin in internal/api/ship_close.go: merge --no-edit, then merge --abort plus a Conflictf naming the HEAD..origin commits on failure. Attempt 1's finding f2 (TestShipFollowRefusesLocalCommits red) is fixed: the test is rewritten as TestShipFollowRefusesConflictingOrigin and PASSes. The full go test -trimpath ./internal/api -count=1 also passes (ok, 594s). The other attempt-1 findings (actor reuse in session.go) are outside this leaf.
